{{Quote|Okay rocket jockeys, fire up your jets! Let's move!|Clone Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] orders a retreat|<ref name="TCW:RH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
'''Clone jet troopers''', or '''aerial clone troopers''', were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] equipped with and trained in the use of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]].

They were the successors of the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]] and [[Darca Nyl]]'s airborne [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] from before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and the predecessors of the [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]] and [[Jumptrooper/Legends|sky troopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Equipment==
[[File:Clone_jet_trooper_BFII.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II]] jet trooper of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].]]
[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] jet troopers were part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Jet troopers utilized their limited flight [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to rapidly cover great distances and gain aerial advantage over their enemies. The agility of the flying jet trooper made him difficult to hit and could ambush their enemies from behind.<ref name="BF I" />

Jet troopers were issued [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[electromagnetic pulse launcher]]s. They were also equipped with the [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 commando pistol]], which was very powerful and accurate, especially for its size. It also had a better cooling capacity so it could continue firing for a long period of time without overheating. They also carried [[V-1 thermal detonator]]s.<ref name="BF I" /> The troopers learned to incorporate their jetpacks in battlefield tactics, sometimes mounting ambushes like the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who had trained them.<ref name="GAR Guide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

Two different types of jet trooper armors were in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The first wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with the addition of a<ref name="BF I" /> short-duration<ref name="BF I guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12 jetpack]].<ref name="BF I" /> They later adopted [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]].<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Kamino uprising|resistance]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] utilized jet troopers as their primary [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]], but carried [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifles]] as one of their primary weapons.<ref name="BF II" />

Phase I jet troopers wore clone trooper [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with green markings.<ref name="BF I" /> Phase II jet trooper lacked these markings, instead having a darker tone with a green visor.

==History==
[[File:TCWRH_Alzoc_III.png|thumb|right|300px|A jet trooper fights beside Commander Gree, [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Unduli]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Secura]] and [[Bly/Legends|Commander Bly]].]]
Jet troopers first saw action at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. They were incorporated into many units,<ref name="BF I">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> one of them being the 501st Legion.<ref name="BF II" />

In the Battle of Geonosis, a jet trooper was assigned to acquire a Geonosian [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that fell from one of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. The holocron was successfully delivered to [[Checkpoint Alpha]] and sent to be analyzed for its secrets. Jet troopers which were part of the 501st Legion also saw action in other battles of the Clone Wars.<ref name="BF II" />

The [[rogue assassin]] wore a suit of jet trooper armor.<ref name="BF II PSP">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] version}}</ref> With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the jet troopers were succeeded by the [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref><ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clone jet troopers are one of the Republic classes in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'' and its [[2005]] sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''. A variant of these troopers, depicted with a winged model of jetpack in the ''Revenge of the Sith'' toy line in 2005 and [[:File:Cloneskytrooper.jpg|concept art]] from [[Warren Fu]], was planned to appear in the cancelled ''Star Wars: Battlefront III'', under the name of "skytrooper."
